text:
sam: quick ask from PM: need a baked evidence-export + retention-concession flow for enterprise pilots (SOC2/ISO).
ria: scope check: audit logs only (auth/admin/kms). no request/response bodies for MVP.
devin: perf note: large snapshots will be async and chunked. plan for job_id + status endpoint. SLA aim: 90% <30m for <=72h ranges.
legal: manifest must include export_id, tenant_id, time_range, event_types, signer_id, storage_kms_id, and immutable retention_exception reference if present.
sam: acceptance criteria draft:
- POST /v1/tenants/:id/exports -> job_id, status url
- signed archive (canonical sha256 + redwood signature)
- retention_exception is a one-time immutable record with approver and duration_days
- artifacts encrypted with tenant CMK when BYOK present, else Redwood CMK
ria: rollout plan: spec RFC -> api + job worker -> signing + manifest -> pilot with 2 customers -> add UI exception flow.
devin: blocker: need infra event taxonomy and prod snapshot worker quota. pinging eng-infra.
legal: blocker: confirm whether contract language must guarantee deletion after exception duration for EU customers.
ops-bot: created task EXPORT-998 for job quota update.
sam: will file PM brief and sync with SRE/legal tomorrow. Drop any final must-haves here.
